translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Taani neena S'oossaa sintsaaninne, de'uwaan de'iyaa asaanne hayk'k'eedda asaa pirddanaw de'iyaa Kiristtoosi Yesuusa sintsan, k'ay Aa yuussaaninne Aa kawutetsaan neena zoray.
K'aalaa oda. Wodii injjetina injjetana d'ayina, minnaade oda. Daro danddayan asaa tamaarissaadde suurissa, seeranne zora.
Ayaw gooppe, Asay tumu timirttiyaa sisennaan is's'iyaa wodii yaanawaa. Shin Asay barenttu amuwaa kaalliide, sisanaw nashechchiyaawaa odiyaa tamaarissiyaawantta gujji gujji shiishshana.
Unttunttu tumu yewuwaa sisiyaawaa aggiide, tossaa sisanaw barenttu haytsaa wora zaarana.
Shin neeni ubbabaan ne huup'iyaa naaganaw bessee. Waayiyaa danddaya. Wonggalaa mishiraachchuwaa odiyaawe ootsiyaa oosuwaa ootsa. S'oossaa k'oomaadan, ne ootsiyaa oosuwaa ubbaa pola.
Taana gidooppe, ta suutsay gukkiide yarshshettiyaa wodiinne k'ay ha de'uwaa aggaade biyaa wodii gakkeedda.
Taani lo"o baas'iyaa baas'etaaddi; wotsaa wos's'aadde wurssaad; ammanuwaakka naagaad.
Sintsappe taw s'illotetsaa kalachchay giigi utteedda. Hewaa s'illo pirddaa pirddiyaa Goday he gallassi taw immana. K'ay Kiristtoosi k'onc'c'anawaa dosiyaa ubba saappe attin, ta s'alalaassa gidenna.
Aa Buzo Allaallatuwabaa
Taakko ellekka yaanaw minna.
Ayaw gooppe, Deemaasi ha alamiyaa dosiide, taana aggiide, Teselonk'k'e giyaa katamaa beedda. K'erk'k'iisi Galaatiyaa giyaa gadiyaa biina, k'ay Tiito Dilmaas'iyaa giyaa gadiyaa beedda.
Luk'aasa s'alalay taananna de'ee. Mark'k'oossi taana kiitaan loytsi maaddanaw danddayiyaa diraw, Aa demmaade neenanna akkaade ya.
Shin taani Tikik'oosa Efesoona giyaa katamaa kiittaad.

Neeni yaadde, S'iro'aadaa giyaa katamaan Karppoosawan taani yeggaade yeedda ta gaabiyaanne k'ay mas'aafatuwaa taw akkaade ya. Shin dummayaade galbbaan s'aafetteedda mas'aafatuwaa ayaa giddoppenne, akkenaan yooppa.
Birataa k'os's'iyaa Iskkinddiri taana daro k'oheedda; Goday aw Aa oosuwaadan zaarana.
I nuuni odiyaawaa loytsi p'alk'k'iyaa diraw, neeni aappe neena naaga.
Koyro taana mootiyaa wode, ubbaykka aggeeddawaappe attin, taana ooninne maaddibeenna. S'oossay hewaa unttunttoo paydoppo.
Shin taani kumentsaa kiitaa Ayihuda gidenna Asay ubbay sisanaw odana mala, Goday ta matan ek'k'iide, taw wolk'k'aa immeedda. K'ay gaammuwaa doonaappekka taana ashsheeda.
Goday taana iitabaa ubbaappe ashshiide, bare saluwaa kawutetsaa sarotetsaan afana; aw med'i med'inaw bonchchuu gido. Amen"i.
Wurssetsa Sarotaa
P'irisk'k'illiw, Ak'iilassinne Henesifooru soy asaw ta sarotaa oda.
Erass's'oosi K'oronttoosa giyaa katamaan atteedda. Shin S'irofiimoosi saketteedda diraw, Miliis'e giyaa katamaan Aa wotsaad.
Balgguu wod'd'anaappe kase yaanaw minna. Ewubuluusi, P'udeesi, Liinoosinne K'ilawude k'ay hara ishatuu ubbaykka neena saro saro giino.
Goday ne ayyaanaanna gido. Aad'o keekatetsay hinttenanna ubbaanna gido. Amen"i.
